company.name: GoGoGrandparent
company.shortDescription: A YC-backed, pre-Series A and profitable startup that lets older folks use personal services like Lyft & Uber from a phone call.
company.description: GoGo (1) gives older adults access to services that give them more independence and (2) monitors those services on behalf of a client base that is more likely not willing or able to hassle with managing these services on their own.

productsAndServices.description: A phone-based service that enables seniors and disabled individuals to request rides from Uber, Lyft, and other providers without needing a smartphone.
productsAndServices.name: On-Demand Senior Transportation Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that arranges meal deliveries from providers like DoorDash to seniors and disabled individuals, accessible with or without a smartphone.
productsAndServices.name: Meal Delivery Service for Seniors

productsAndServices.description: A phone-accessible service that helps seniors and disabled individuals order groceries from providers like Instacart without needing a smartphone.
productsAndServices.name: Grocery Delivery Service for Seniors
